{{Quote|Senator, we're making our final approach into Coruscant.|Theomet Danlé, to Cordé|<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Theomet Danlé''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] to a family of [[Mining/Legends|miners]], he decided to break tradition and serve in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. He was eventually assigned to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], serving as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. When [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], the incumbent [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], opened her [[Planet/Legends|world's]] borders to [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from all over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], his family's mining industry suffered as the [[Spaceport/Legends|ports]] were overworked.

Danlé's family sunk into poverty, and his [[Theomet Danlé's grandfather|grandfather]] [[Death/Legends|died]], forcing him to become a fierce critic of his [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] policies. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the disenchanted Danlé let a [[Zam Wesell/Legends|journalist]] onto the Senator's [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]] to plant a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]]. What he did not realize was that the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] Zam Wesell and that the listening device was an explosive, which was detonated sometime afterward, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Danlé.

==Biography==
===Serving Naboo===
[[File:PadmeGreenDress-WoSW.png|thumb|right|220px|Theomet Danlé was a lieutenant for Senator Padmé Amidala.]]
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] to a [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]]-based family that had been [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]] for over eight generations, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Theomet Danlé sought a career outside the one presented by his family. He applied to join the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and did so successfully, with both exceptional aptitude scores and physical achievements. Although he initially found it difficult to stray from family tradition, he acquitted himself well while serving in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], and he sent what income he could back to his family at Kwilaan. He eventually came to serve as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] for the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector's]] representative in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="db" />

When the growing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] threatened the stability of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], opened borders, allowing refugees, displaced by the secession of worlds to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], to find sanctuary on her planet. As a result, the outlying ports, such as Kwilaan, were over strained, and in turn, the mining business of Naboo suffered. Danlé's family was hit hard by the new development, and was forced to rely on his income. The money was not enough, however, and his family sank into poverty, with Danlé's [[Theomet Danlé's grandfather|grandfather]] passing away due to his greatly deteriorated lifestyle. His family was devastated, and Danlé's faith in both his monarch and his charge, Amidala, who supported Jamillia's policies, was shaken.<ref name="db" />

===Disappointment in Amidala===
[[File:Naboo_senatorial_cruiser.png|thumb|left|250px|The senator's barge explodes, killing Danlé.]]
One night<ref name="db" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Danlé ventured into a local bar and turned to drink, which loosened his tongue. In the crowded location, he began making loud criticisms of Jamillia and Amidala, which attracted the attention of a [[Zam Wesell/Legends|woman]] claiming to be a local [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]]. The journalist claimed that she wanted to expose Amidala, but in order to do so, she needed access to the senator's [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]]. In a fit of bad judgment, perhaps also beguiled by the woman's appearance, Danlé agreed and let the journalist onto the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to plant what he believed to be a listening device. What he did not know was that the journalist was actually Zam Wesell,<ref name="db" /> a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who had been hired to kill Amidala.<ref name="aotc" />

When the senator made her journey to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to vote against the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], Danlé was aboard the barge. As it touched down on a landing platform and the passengers disembarked, Wesell remotely detonated the "listening device"&mdash;actually a powerful explosive. The ship was ripped apart instantly,<ref name="aotc" /> and Danlé perished in the blast.<ref name="db" /> However, the senator had not been on the ship at all, and instead, one of her handmaidens, [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]], had taken her place and died in her stead.<ref name="aotc" />

==Personality and traits==
A gifted and skilled individual, Danlé initially performed well in his role as a security guard. However, as the years went by, he let his personal feelings get in the way of his job, particularly when Jamillia's refugee policies led to the death of his [[Parent/Legends|grandfather]] and the destitution of his family. He turned to drink in his time of desperation, and his disenchantment with his senator almost led to her assassination on Coruscant. He had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and stood 1.82 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" />

==Equipment==
Danlé wore the standard [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] and [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] of a member of the Royal Naboo Security Force and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Theomet Danlé first appeared as the "Naboo Lieutenant" in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. He was portrayed by [[Steve John Shepherd]].<ref name="aotc" /> The character was later identified and given a story by "[[winstonvalleyjedi]]" through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]"<ref name="db" />
